result.summary: Found 3 issues: an untranslated placeholder key visible as section title, a cut-off card at the horizontal scroll edge, and minor category filter list appears clipped at screen edge.

issues.description: The section title displays raw localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of translated text
issues.suggestion: Fix the localization binding so the proper translated string (e.g. 'Popular near you') is rendered instead of the raw key

issues.description: The third restaurant card ('Trattoria Piccol...') under 'Fastest near you' is cut off at the right edge of the screen with no visual indication of scrollability
issues.suggestion: Add a partial fade/gradient or peek indicator to signal horizontal scrolling, or ensure consistent card cropping

issues.description: The category filter chips (All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) are cut off at the right edge, showing a partially clipped next item
issues.suggestion: Add scroll affordance styling (fade edge) so users understand the list is scrollable
